hooks.name: Deny formulary write (file tools)
hooks.description: Only the review pipeline writes afterglow-formulary/validated/**. Agents write proposals to proposals/** and review-queue/**.

action.command: in=$(cat); p=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.. | (.path? // .targetFile? // .sourcePath? // .destinationPath? // empty) | strings' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$p" ] || p="$in"; if printf '%s' "$p" | grep -Eq 'afterglow-formulary/+validated([^[:alnum:]_-]|$)'; then echo 'deny-formulary-write: the validated formulary is written only by the review pipeline after pharmacist approval. Write a proposal under proposals/ instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
